description: bounded DC endpoint/assumed-state screening; not SPICE, time-waveform, silicon failure or pass

pin.release: Q_RELEASE collector=CLAMP_B, emitter=GND_SYS, base via 10k from LPV_DRV_LOCAL and 100k to ground
pin.hard: Q_PMOS_CTRL collector=DUMP_OFF untouched; R1 UCC IN+=GUARD_OK, so real hard takeover also requires GUARD_OK valid high

supervisor.guard_early_3_45v: not guaranteed regulated 3.3V; TLV760 input includes series hold diode and dropout

limits: An actual intermediate-voltage logic output is unspecified; 1.5V is one admissible assumption, not a guaranteed output.
VBE=0.7V, VCE=0.2V and 3.6V logic drive are illustrations, not all-temperature saturation guarantees.
The present MMBT5551 VCEsat data at IC=10mA/IB=1mA and 25 C cannot validate these low-current corners.
No hold diode Vf, guard load, supervisor VDD slope, reset load, clamp storage or loss sequencing guarantee is supplied.
UCC threshold does not establish actual MOS VGS, current or full functionality at 3.45–3.7V; R1 IN+=GUARD_OK must be high to permit either request.
